title: Old maps show Antarctica as two islands

tellings.quote: map, but one of them shows that Antarctica actually consists of two islands that are very close together.

plain: One old map shows Antarctica not as a single continent but as 'two islands that are very close together.' The writer Jason Jorjani makes this point to Michels while discussing two early maps, the Piri Reis map and the Oronteus Finaeus map, and does not say who first made this reading. If true, it would suggest the mapmakers knew something about Antarctica's shape that nobody is supposed to have known at the time.
